asset.name: Stellar

score_rationales.supply: XLM has a fixed cap of about 50.0 billion lumens after the SDF burned roughly 55.44 billion XLM on 4 Nov 2019, and the prior 1% annual inflation was removed by validator vote on 28 Oct 2019—so there is no ongoing minting, only modest on-chain fee destruction. Recent market snapshots list circulating supply around ~33.3 billion of ~50.0 billion max (~two-thirds floated), with the remainder largely Stellar Development Foundation reserves—transparent reporting but meaningful concentration and discretionary release risk versus pure free-float distribution. The network uses SCP (no PoS staking yield); exchange reserve trends were not taken from a labeled on-chain feed here, so reserve dynamics are treated as neutral beyond that fixed-supply and foundation-overhang trade-off.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: Evidence includes SDF 2025 figures (~10.3M unique addresses, 632k monthly active addresses up 24% YoY, $55.6B payment volume up 52% YoY) and Messari Q1 2026 (~$297M on-chain stablecoin market cap with USDC ~$256.3M, RWA market cap over ~$1.52B at quarter-end, ~$16.5M average daily Soroban smart-contract volume). Messari also reports QoQ declines in average daily transfer volume and in XLM-denominated payment flows as usage tilts toward stablecoins and RWAs.
